angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,146,514 km at 178.18 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6122 +/- 0.0172 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 178.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.648 +/- 0.045 solar radii from Baliwal et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6038 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract): 1,146,514 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.291 +/- 0.066 solar masses from Baliwal et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6038 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6110 +/- 100 K from Baliwal et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6038 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Baliwal et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6038 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6038-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.115, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 275354: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6038 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.124 dex, from Baliwal et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6038 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.53275, from Baliwal et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6038 A (pscomppars): age 3.65 Gyr, from Baliwal et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6038 A (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7.94 km/s, from Baliwal et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..147B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
